svg.title: La Rebelion Labs — Inside HAPI MCP: The Protocol Layer
svg.desc: Zoom-in on the protocol layer: OpenAPI and Arazzo contracts feed the HAPI engine, which routes them through the OpenAPI plugin and HAPI Workflows plugin to a single secure /mcp endpoint, which proxies governed calls to production APIs — all resting on the same contracts and backends foundation.
